proposal.value: 1. Optical Integrity: Lens flares and halations must be organic and soft, avoiding extreme highlight clipping or harsh digital-looking halos. 2. Shadow & Contrast: Shadows must cast realistically according to a single warm light source, preserving clean local contrast so brand logos and bottom text remain fully legible against dark regions. 3. Text & Brand Safety: Eliminate any duplicate text, ghosting, or artifacts of the 'Osiris' name on the device surface. 4. Composition & Backgrounds: Frame the hero product naturally to avoid awkward empty corners, ensuring ground textures are coherent and free of AI generation distortions. 5. CTA Execution: Call-to-action elements must feature precise alignment, crisp margins, and optimal contrast to guarantee premium legibility in tight banner dimensions.
proposal.rationale: By replacing the default craft canon with explicit rules targetting lens flare clipping, shadow contrast, text ghosting, and CTA alignment, we directly address the specific structural defects flagged by the judge.

proposal.value: Campaign: the launch of 'Osiris', a palm-sized portable solar phone charger with a warm amber solar panel face and matte black body. Palette lock: warm amber, matte black, off-white; golden-hour light without direct lens flare. Style: premium minimalist lifestyle photography of the device being actively held in hand. Avoid static surface-resting compositions, harsh digital halation, and muddy shadows. Maintain clean, well-lit balanced framing with clear, high-contrast areas for text legibility, and no text or brand logos rendered directly on the physical device body.
proposal.rationale: We revise the brief to mandate active handheld interaction to fix static composition issues, ban direct lens flares and muddy shadows to resolve rendering artifacts, and prohibit physical on-device branding to eliminate text duplication errors.

proposal.value: Quiet sunlit utility. Osiris turns raw morning light into power you can carry, where every frame centers on a single, highly-focused subject with crisp, natural shadows and zero digital flares. The scene features clean, uncomplicated environments—such as smooth, undistorted natural ground—relying on strong tonal contrast between the matte black device and its background. The product is either held naturally in hand or placed in a balanced composition that leaves clear, uncluttered zones. Restraint signals premium: no busy textures, no printed text on the physical device, and soft golden light that never clips.
proposal.rationale: We update the creative worldview to mandate soft golden light without digital flares, undistorted natural surfaces, high contrast for matte black elements, and a clean physical device face to systematically eliminate rendering artifacts, text ghosting, and composition issues.
